source: Every switch the master build prompt names (sections 15 and 16). The schema always carries the shape; a switch decides whether a room renders it, asks for it, or an engine applies it. A user-scope switch lives under prefs and is toggled from Settings; a situation-scope switch is set by the situation gate and is not toggleable.
confidenceNote: Defaults are the prompt's: the beginner path starts with only the default-on set; the FI path starts with Accuracy and Horizon all on.
note: Read by shared/features.js (D-180). Features.on(id, household) is the only way an engine or room checks a switch; no room reads this file directly. Flipping any switch on and off leaves the household byte-identical: switches change rendering and engines, never stored facts. `group` is the Settings heading: Accuracy (what makes numbers more honest), Household (who is in it), Horizon (age and time), Advanced (what a beginner should not see). `situationWhen` is one of a few fixed phrases the library reads for a situation-scope switch.

groups.label: Accuracy
groups.line: The phenomena that make the numbers more honest.

groups.label: Advanced
groups.line: What a beginner should not have to see.

afterTaxNetWorth.label: Show net worth after deferred tax
afterTaxNetWorth.gloss: A 401(k) dollar is not a whole dollar. Show what's left after the tax you'll owe on it.

showNominal.label: Show projections in future dollars too
showNominal.gloss: Every projection is in today's money. This adds the future-dollar figure beside it, converted at the inflation assumption.

annualLines.label: Also once a year
annualLines.gloss: Insurance, gifts, registration: named yearly costs that sit inside their bucket and are spread over the month everywhere but the calendar.

showMilestones.label: Show the age milestones on timelines
showMilestones.gloss: 50, 55, 59 and a half, 62, 65, 67, 70, 73: faint markers where a rule changes, with the rule on hover.

sequenceRisk.label: Order-of-returns risk
sequenceRisk.gloss: The order returns arrive in matters once you're spending from the pot. A bad first five years can sink a plan that averages fine.

preMedicare.label: Health cover before 65
preMedicare.gloss: Between leaving work and 65, health cover is a real line, and its cost depends on what you report as income.

incomeFloor.label: Social Security and pensions as a floor
incomeFloor.gloss: Money that arrives whether or not the market does. It lowers how much the pot has to cover.

equityComp.label: Equity compensation
equityComp.gloss: Shares you're promised aren't shares you have yet. Show what's vested, what's coming, and what the tax will be.

matchVesting.label: Employer match and vesting
matchVesting.gloss: Match money isn't yours until it vests. Leaving early can cost you part of it.

homeDetail.label: Home ownership specifics
homeDetail.gloss: A house costs more than the mortgage, and it's worth less than the listing when you sell.

inheritanceRules.label: Inheritance rules
inheritanceRules.gloss: What you inherit, and how, changes what tax you owe and how fast you must take it.

studentLoanPaths.label: Student loan paths
studentLoanPaths.gloss: Federal loans have payment plans tied to what you earn, and some jobs erase the balance after ten years.

jobLossCushions.label: Job-loss cushions
jobLossCushions.gloss: Losing a job usually comes with something: severance, unemployment, and the option to keep health cover for a while.

agingParents.label: Aging parents
agingParents.gloss: Helping a parent is a line most plans leave out until it's already happening.

givingVehicles.label: Charitable vehicles
givingVehicles.gloss: There are ways to give that lower your tax bill more than writing a cheque.

timeBudget.label: Time and energy as a budget
timeBudget.gloss: Hours are the other thing you spend. Every plan that needs your time should show the bill.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.line: Starts with only the switches that are on by default.

fi.label: FI
fi.line: Starts with Accuracy and Horizon all on.
